snippet.title: How Many Dudes? Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934270/How_Many_Dudes/)
Find out How Many Dudes it takes to defeat:
10 Toddlers
4 Dog-sized Rats
6 Wolves and an Alpha
1 Silverback Gorilla
GOD
-----
Enter the Dude Ranch, where you recruit Dudes to fight in an arena against ever escalating challenges. Improve your Ranch, manage your Dudes, and see just how many it takes to beat-up a Gorilla.

Want to play an early version of How Many Dudes? Head over to https://bscotch.itch.io/how-many-dudes, and you can play it in your browser!
